title: Our Story
claims: The page states: Founded in 1871, the U.S. standard-setting organization is governed by the chief insurance regulators from the 50 states, the District of Columbia, and five U.S. territories to coordinate regulation of multistate insurers.
The page states that the National Association of Insurance Commissioners provides expertise, data, and analysis for insurance commissioners to effectively regulate the industry and protect consumers.
The page states that NAIC also provides consumer protection and education, data collection and analysis, technology, financial assessments and reporting, and licensing and testing.
updateCadence: Maintained by NAIC; self-description changes infrequently.
